function.arguments: {"observation": "`customer_age` contains 108 values of exactly -1, which the documentation confirms is a sentinel for missing age data (not a real age). This is 12% of the data.", "implication": "While the question does not ask about age, this missingness could affect the revenue distribution if age is correlated with spending. However, since the question is only about mean revenue of completed orders, and no age-based filtering or adjustment is requested, this missingness does not change the estimand. The mean revenue can still be computed on the full completed orders, even if some have missing age. It does not bias the mean unless age is a confounder, which is not part of this question. Thus, no action is needed."}
function.name: note_finding
